cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Access Has a Price
cards.instruction: Turn every piece of access, information, or approval into a favor, debt, or condition.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll introduce you to the curator if you hang my exhibition. Introduction only; let's be precise about the arrangement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll hang it Saturday. Can you send her portfolio requirements now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's submission advice. Collect my frames as well, please, and I'll send the requirements with the hanging plan.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. Give me her email; I'll ask her directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Direct contact is the full package: hanging and taking down. Put Sunday in your diary before I send the address, please.

reason: Use expert scope labels to convert each information or contact request into distinct exhibition obligations without generic professional narration.
